scientific_intent.scientific_task: Convert Float32 values into exact E4M3FN and E5M2 8-bit encoding codes under two explicit overflow/NaN policies
scientific_intent.mathematical_operation: Nearest representable binary floating-point encoding, ties to even, with signed zeros/subnormals. Original reference non-saturating paths preserve NaN sign and map overflow to NaN(E4) or Inf(E5); vendor SATFINITE paths saturate finite range and canonicalize NaNs positive.
scientific_intent.discretization: 5099 shared actual Float32 raw bitpatterns, both signs of all target codepoints and Float32 below/tie/above every midpoint, NaN payloads/Inf/zero/subnormal,3073 seededxorshift rawbits. Four genuine paths,31 output guardbytes/path.
scientific_intent.accuracy_requirements: Exact UInt8 output code for each policy, not closeness to original Float32 realvalue. Independent Float64 enumerated-codebook nearest-even oracle; all20 artifacts25619 UInt32(serialized rawbits +losslesslywidened codebytes) exact,124guardbytes exact.
scientific_intent.input_size_regime: Named small numerical boundary fixture with20launches/path,5trialsmeanlast4; not original268435456elements/100iterations throughput regime.
scientific_intent.precision_sensitivity: Device Float32input,UInt8encodedoutput. Portable Float32denormmagicaddition/UInt32bitrounding and SATFINITE clamp. Vendor CUDA12 sm70fallback widens Float32 to Float64 then UInt64bitlogic; no Float64 accuracy/computethroughput claim or nativeFP8ISA. RawNaNpayloads serializedUInt32, not NaN-valued floatcomparisons.
scientific_intent.community_use_case: Low-precision storage and conversion for scientific/ML arrays; no downstream simulation/training quality or application accuracy guarantee.
scientific_intent.description: All four original native kernels execute unchanged on V100 including vendor softwarefallback. Historical Julia smoke/PASS stub archived and replaced by real source-derived bit encoders; KA/JACC execute pure portable encoding kernels using shared helper authored once in reference phase.
scientific_intent.provenance: Source-reviewed CUDA12 header sm90 ISA guard/softwarefallback and independent enumerated target-value oracle. Numerical contract perpath distinguishes intentionally different policies; no diagnosis of native scientific bug or unsupported hardware solely fromFP8name.
